title: Regularizing Hard Examples Improves Adversarial Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2611.30065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies have validated that pruning hard-to-learn examples from training improves the generalization performance of neural networks (NNs). In this study, we investigate this intriguing phenomenon -- the negative effect of hard examples on generalization -- in adversarial training. Particularly, we theoretically demonstrate that the increase in the difficulty of hard examples in adversarial training is significantly greater than the increase in the difficulty of easy examples. Furthermore, we verify that hard examples are only fitted through memorization of the label in adversarial training. We conduct both theoretical and empirical analyses of this memorization phenomenon, showing that pruning hard examples in adversarial training can enhance the model's robustness. translated_title: 正则化困难样本可提升对抗鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 最近的研究已经验证了从训练中剪除难以学习的样本可以提升神经网络（NNs）的泛化性能。在本研究中，我们在对抗训练的背景下探究了这一有趣的现象——困难样本对泛化的负面影响。特别地，我们从理论上证明，在对抗训练中困难样本难度的增加显著大于简单样本难度的增加。此外，我们验证了在对抗训练中困难样本仅通过对标签的记忆来拟合。我们对这种记忆现象进行了理论和实证分析，表明在对抗训练中剪除困难样本可以增强模型的鲁棒性。然而，挑战在于如何找到去除损害鲁棒性能的困难样本的最优阈值。基于这些观察，我们提出……
tldr: 本文揭示了对抗训练中困难样本仅通过记忆标签被拟合且难度增幅远超简单样本的机理，并提出通过对困难样本进行正则化处理来提升模型的对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that hard examples in adversarial training are fitted only through label memorization and their difficulty increases far more than easy examples, proposing to regularize hard examples to improve adversarial robustness.
